R1.evidence: Loads 60+ students across two classes with six compulsory subjects, one optional subject, separate theory/practical marks, and a distinct AB state.

R2.evidence: Pure grading functions implement every published grade band, separate practical pass gate, optional bonus, divisor/cap, compulsory-failure override, GPA, and final letter.

R3.evidence: Per-student evidence shows actual marks, subject GP, exact applied rule, failure reasons, optional contribution, uncancelled average, and final GPA.

R4.evidence: Independent optional GP<=2/AB, practical<8, and any-AB checking lists follow clarification R-29 and allow overlapping membership.

known_limitations: Bonus row-level rejected-input reporting supports pasted P08 JSON case data rather than XLSX/CSV parsing.
Data is session-only; authentication and permanent school result storage are production follow-ups.
